items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: a friend of mine who I’d gone to school with... We had remained friends all those years

ctx.x: I don’t know. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

I just heard he died a few months ago or last year. But there really wasn’t anything there that was doing me any good career-wise. And a friend of mine who I’d gone to school with who was in that band at City College, named Jules Chaikin, called me. We had remained friends all those years and he said, “how are you doing there?” And I said, “well I’m doing fine.” And he asked me what I was making, just like that. And I said, “well I’m making maybe six-fifty a week.” And he said, “well that’s not bad,” but he said,…
T.V. and film and commercials, and just anything.
